many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

from collections import Counter

from collections import Counter
def info(k):
    A=G[k+' input'];B=G[k+' output']
    R,C=len(A),len(A[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in A for v in r)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    zrows=[r for r in range(R) if all(A[r][c]==0 for c in range(C))]
    zcols=[c for c in range(C) if all(A[r][c]==0 for r in range(R))]
    all5=[c for c in range(C) if all(A[r][c]==dom for r in range(R))]
    # column blocks bounded by zcols or all5-cols
    sp=zcols|set(all5)
    cb=[];cur=[]
    for c in range(C):
        cur.append(c)
        if c==C-1 or (c<C-1 and c+1 in sp):
            cb.append((cur[0],cur[-1])); cur=[]
    if cur: cb.append((cur[0],cur[-1]))
    return A,B,R,C,dom,zrows,zcols,all5,cb

    for r in zrows:
        if pr<=r-1: brs.append((pr,r-1)); pr=r+1
